## Overview

**Zan** -- born **Vaelis Zandorian** -- is a Shadow Elf (Shadar-kai) rogue whose life was shaped by abandonment, survival, and transformation. Born into a noble family in the Shadar-kai shadow-city of the Shadowfell, he was marked by the Raven Queen's brand at age 7 and secretly exiled to the Material Plane. After years of survival under a brutal crime lord, Zan's innate teleportation awakened when the Raven Queen answered his desperate prayer. He was sold to the **Flesh Architects** (Covenant research division), subjected to horrific experiments as Subject 242, and permanently changed by the **Catalyst Project** -- B Crystals that made him **B-touched**.

He escaped at age 13, and has spent the years since as an assassin and bounty hunter, gathering power to destroy the Flesh Architects, hunt down J.B., and rescue **Sophie (Subject 241)** .

---

## Appearance

A lean Shadow Elf with pale grey skin and silver-white hair cropped short for practicality. His eyes are pale violet, holding an unnatural glint that flickers when his power stirs. Faint silvery scars trace patterns across his arms and chest -- remnants of the Flesh Architects' experiments. Scarred nicks on his ear tips from J.B.'s mutilation. He dresses in dark, practical leathers designed for silence and mobility. The Raven Queen's brand is always kept covered.

## Full Backstory

### Chapter 1: The Cradle Without Stairs (Birth to Age 7)

Before being "The Rest," his name was Vaelis Zandorian. He was born into a structured, middle-upper class Shadar-kai family in the shadow-city of the Shadowfell -- the son of **Ashura Zando** and **Athena Orion**.

The first seven years of his life were peaceful and happy. The Shadar-kai shadow-city was a place of advanced architecture: majestic buildings, perfectly constructed, but without a single staircase, designed for a race that moves through shadows and teleportation. Contrary to ignorant rumors from the outside world -- which claim the Shadar-kai live in isolated tents -- they guard fragments of a formidable and highly developed metropolis.

### Chapter 2: The Brand and the Exile (Age 7)

At age 7, the **Raven Queen's brand** manifested on Zan's body. This mark appears on direct bloodline descendants of the Raven Queen -- who once took mortal form, descended to the Material Plane, and had children with a mortal. The brand signifies that the Queen has chosen the bearer, that they are destined for great things.

But to the Shadar-kai, the mark also means the Elf is chosen, that the Queen has faith in them. The Zandorion family was middle-upper class and could not protect Zan from higher families' interests and manipulations. Since Zan was the youngest ever to receive the mark, he became a target of envy, jealousy, hate, and harsh judgment.

To protect Zan, the family decided to abandon him in secret, modify his memory so he would not know why, and replace him with an orphan named **Dun'vis**, who looked physically similar to Zan. They added a tattooed replica of the mark to Dun'vis and trained him to take Zan's place -- making sure Zan would not be chased or hunted down.

The Zandorion family is kind but tough on Dun'vis, and sometimes their pain surfaces as misguided anger toward him.

Through his childhood and adolescence, Dun'vis is hunted, ridiculed, envied, bullied, and mistreated by high-class families. He learns to defend himself through intense, rigorous training, fighting off kidnappers and assassination attempts. Dun'vis ends up very hateful toward Zan, without knowing who he is or why he hates him. For Dun'vis, Zan defined his whole existence since he disappeared: he had to like the same things Zan liked, act exactly like Zan, become Zan, and erase Dun'vis. So Dun'vis hunts Zan to bring him back home, expose the Zandorion plan, and get his own life back.

The phrase that drives Dun'vis: *"I want my life back. I want my name back. I want myself back."*

### Chapter 3: Streets, the False Savior, and Mutilation (Ages 7-11)

For months, Zan drifted as a seven-year-old child with no one, stealing to survive. He was found by **J.B.**, a human crime lord in his 40s who ran a guild of thieves, assassins, and "ring bearers."

J.B. was not an adoptive father. He was a master. The training was relentless, intense, and severe. The rule was simple and cruel: if you messed up, you got beaten.

During a mission where a disguise threatened to fail, J.B. -- with brutal coldness -- cut off the tips of Zan's elven ears to force the disguise to hold.

When Zan revealed his aristocratic surname, J.B. spat on it:

> *"You? Zandorion? You're just shit. Nothing... Now that you're talking about it, you're going to start being Zan, which goes against who you are."*

Vaelis died there. **Zan** was born. The Rest.

### Chapter 4: The Leap of Faith and Betrayal (Age 11)

At age 11, during a mission that went catastrophically wrong, Zan was trapped. The only escape was a fatal 30-foot cliff. Consumed by despair and adrenaline, he jumped without thinking. Suspended in the air, almost falling toward the end, he asked for help inside.

And in the silence of despair, **the Raven Queen answered.**

His innate Shadar-kai teleportation awakened, saving his life and allowing him to reach the other side. But this divine victory became his curse. J.B. witnessed the awakening and saw Zan as a valuable commodity. He sold Zan to the **Flesh Architects** (Arquitetos da Carne) -- the Crimson Covenant's research division.

### Chapter 5: The Blood Laboratory, the Stones, and Subject 242 (Ages 11-13)

From ages 11 to 13, Zan experienced true hell at the hands of the Flesh Architects. He went from being a street killer to a piece of meat at the mercy of sadistic scientists and unethical wizards. They were not interested in his combat skills; they wanted to dissect his race's innate connection to the Shadowfell and the moment the Raven Queen responded to him.

His identity was obliterated and replaced by a number: **Subject 242**.

The tests did not seek to improve him, but to break him to understand how his biology worked. The tortures took on a terrifying clinical coldness:

- **The Void Drain**: Repeatedly submerged in tanks of icy alchemical fluids that simulated the Shadowfell. The Architects kept him there until his lungs gave out, only to revive him at the last second, trying to measure the dark energy his body released when on the verge of death.
- **Arcane Dissection**: Strapped to cold iron tables, incisions along his spine without anesthesia. Silver wires and poisoned needles inserted directly into his nervous system, trying to "fish" and physically extract the magical reflex that made him teleport, causing spasms of pain that lasted for days.
- **The Catalyst Project**: The macabre turning point. The Architects realized his teleportation could not be extracted with blades -- it had to be **requested**. They immobilized him and spread heavy, red-glowing heated stones imbued with raw magic directly on his naked skin and flesh. These stones -- actually **B Crystals** (arcane-reactive crystals) -- began to burn and merge with his aura. The agony was so great that his survival instinct took over. The magic of the stones penetrated his pores and, to avoid being disintegrated, his body absorbed it, permanently changing how his natural teleportation works. Today, he can resist damage when he moves through the shadows -- his body learned to use desperation and intrusive energy as a shield.

But in the midst of all this darkness, there was a sliver of light. Zan shared his "rest" moments with **Sophie, Subject 241**. In the short intervals of silence in the lab, they healed each other's wounds. During those two excruciating years, their shared horrors turned into an unbreakable connection -- a pure and profound love born in the ugliest place on earth. Sophie was the only reason his mind had not completely shattered when the magic stones burned his soul.

### Chapter 6: The Escape (Age 13)

During one of the Catalyst Project experiments, an escape opportunity arose. Zan successfully teleported out of the chair he was bound to, accidentally killing the bodyguard in the room. He grabbed a nearby scalpel and, out of pure rage, stabbed the so-called scientist in the room until they were nothing more than a pile of blood, mutilated flesh, and regret.

Zan ran out of the room, sprinted down a hallway, made several turns -- the alarm had been raised, multiple guards now chasing him. He was cornered. There was only one way out: a window that would lead to a 100-ft drop. He made his choice -- better die a free person than live as an imprisoned one.

He jumped, arms flailing. One of the rune stones that was under Zan's skin flew out. And then he felt it: the stone, the magical essence -- he could use it as an anchor. A teleportation anchor.

And so, like a similar time in Zan's recent past, he closed his eyes, begged for help, focused on the stone, and waited for a miracle. One second passed, then 3, then 8. Almost 15 seconds had passed, and he had not heard an answer. The fall would take around this much time to hit the ground, so if his end was coming, he wanted to see it -- he opened his eyes, expecting to see the fast-approaching street floor.

Instead, he saw the rooftop floor, the city landscape, the skies above him, the street level beneath him, the building he just jumped off 40 ft standing behind him, a single raven feather on the floor nearby, and a glimpse of hope on the horizon.

Zan ran, ran and ran. Hid, stole, survived. Settled down, started working as an assassin and a bounty hunter.

### Chapter 7: The Rest (Age 13 to Present)

Now, at 29 years old, Zan seeks to gather enough power and resources to take down the Flesh Architects, hunt down J.B., put an end to the Flesh Architects, and rescue Sophie (if she's still alive) from their hands.

## DM's Notes -- Plot Hooks & Connections

### Narrative Gaps (Open Plot Hooks)

1. **[HOOK] The Age-7 Trauma -- Memory Modification**: Zan's memory of the abandonment was magically modified by his parents. The true reason is buried in his mind. Recovery triggers: (1) encountering the brand on his own body, (2) meeting Dun'vis and seeing the tattooed replica, (3) a triggering event or magical revelation, (4) a confrontation with his parents.

2. **[HOOK] The Zandorion Family**: Ashura Zando and Athena Orion are alive in the Shadowfell. They believe Zan is safe. Dun'vis hunts him. If Zan returns to the Shadowfell, he will find a family that never stopped loving him -- and a replacement who wants his life back.

3. **[HOOK] The Shadowfell Shadow-City**: The Shadar-kai capital is a location waiting to be explored. A city of no-staircase architecture, noble politics, and the Raven Queen's influence.

4. **[HOOK] Sophie (Subject 241)**: Her fate is unknown. She could be: (A) still held by the Flesh Architects, (B) moved to another Covenant facility, (C) experimented to death, (D) alive and changed -- empowered or broken by further experiments.

5. **[HOOK] J.B. (The Collector)**: A human crime lord now in his 50s-60s. He may still run his guild or have risen in the underworld. He knows about the Flesh Architects and the Covenant -- he has sold them other "merchandise." A potential source of intelligence.

6. **[HOOK] The Flesh Architects Facilities**: The Architects maintain hidden research facilities (number and locations to be defined by the GM). Zan escaped from one. Others may still hold prisoners, records, and secrets.

### Character Connections

- **[Aurora Asteria]** : Aurora's twin brother Polaris may have been experimented into a Shadow Elf by the Covenant. If so, he could be in the same Shadowfell city where Zan was born, or connected to Zan's family. They share a B-touched resonance -- they may sense each other.

- **[Balor Skallfang]** : Both are victims of the Crimson Covenant's experiments -- Zan (Flesh Architects, Catalyst Project) and Balor (Project Genesis). The Flesh Architects may have worked alongside the Project Genesis team. Both carry permanent magical modifications. They share a common enemy.

- **[Odessa Merikh]** : Eryx's proof documents elven leadership surrendering captives to the Covenant's experiments -- the same experiments that created Shadow Elves. Zan's ancestors may have been among those surrendered elves. Tangential but meaningful connection.

- **[Dun'vis]** : The orphan who replaced Zan. Now hunts him. Their confrontation is inevitable -- and deeply personal.

### World Secrets Connections

- **[B-Touched Status]** : The B Crystals used on Zan were fragments of B's essence (arcane-reactive crystals). Zan is now B-touched: (1) he may have visions or dreams connected to B's consciousness, (2) he may feel a subtle pull toward locations where B's essence is concentrated, (3) other B-touched individuals (Aurora, potentially Polaris) may sense him, (4) the Flesh Architects may be able to track him through B Crystal resonance signatures.

- **[The Raven Queen]** : Zan does NOT revere or worship the Raven Queen, despite carrying her brand and having been saved by her. His feelings are complex -- gratitude, resentment, confusion, and suspicion of her motives. Why did she mark him? Why did she save him? What does she want from him?

- **[The Arcane Weave]** : Zan's modified teleportation draws directly from the Weave. As a B-touched individual, his abilities may grow stronger near ley line convergences or crystal deposits -- or attract unwanted attention from entities that sense B's resonance.

- **[The Crimson Covenant]** : Zan's existence is a loose end for the Covenant. Subject 242 escaped with B Crystal-modified abilities. The Covenant may want him back -- not as a prisoner, but as a successful test subject to study and replicate.

## Abilities

- **Innate Shadar-kai Teleportation (Awakened)**: Teleport short distances through shadows. Awakened at age 11 when the Raven Queen answered.
- **Modified Teleportation (Catalyst Project)**: B Crystals permanently altered his teleportation. He can **resist damage** when teleporting.
- **Marks (Homebrew Feature)**: Zan can imbue objects, people, or places with his magical essence as **marks**. As a bonus action, he can teleport to a marked target over short ranges. Limited number of active marks.
- **B-Touched Resonance**: Attuned to B's lingering will in the Weave. May sense concentrations of B's essence or be sensed by other B-touched entities.
- **Rogue Skills**: Lockpicking, stealth, perception, acrobatics, assassination.
- **Shadowfell Attunement**: Darkvision, natural stealth, connection to darkness.

## Goals

1. Destroy the **Flesh Architects** -- burn every facility, kill every scientist
2. Hunt down **J.B.** -- the man who mutilated, named, and sold him
3. Rescue **Sophie** -- find Subject 241, if she still lives
4. Understand his past -- the brand, the abandonment, Dun'vis
5. Forge his own identity beyond the names others gave him
